claims.claim: Revenue was $96.2 billion.
Revenue was up 106% year over year.
Revenue was up 18% quarter over quarter.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion.
Data Center revenue was up 117% year over year.
Data Center revenue was up 18% quarter over quarter.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were both 75.0%.
Gross margins (GAAP and non-GAAP) were up 2.6 pts year over year.
claims.note: Only GAAP gross margin rose 2.6 pts (72.4% to 75.0%); non-GAAP rose 2.5 pts (72.5% to 75.0%). The brief applies the GAAP change to both bases.

claims.claim: GAAP net income was $59.7 billion.
GAAP net income was up 126% year over year.
GAAP net income was up 2% quarter over quarter.
NVIDIA returned $26.0 billion to shareholders via share repurchases and dividends in the quarter.
Data Center accounted for 92.5% of total revenue.
claims.note: The release gives no revenue-mix percentage; 89.0/96.221 is a calculation the release does not show.

claims.claim: Vera Rubin is ramping into full production with racks at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion.
Edge Computing revenue was up 27% year over year.
Edge Computing revenue was up 13% quarter over quarter.
NVIDIA introduced the NVIDIA Vera CPU during the quarter.
NVIDIA introduced the Groq 3 LPX inference accelerator.
NVIDIA launched the NVIDIA DSX platform for designing and operating AI factories.
NVIDIA announced strategic partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone and others to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure.
Third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue guidance is $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
The revenue guidance assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.
Third-quarter GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
Third-quarter GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be $9.2 billion and $9.0 billion, respectively.
Approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization at quarter end.
Cash and cash equivalents were $22.4 billion.
Cash and cash equivalents rose from $10.6 billion in the prior quarter.
claims.note: The $10,605M comparative is the January 25, 2026 fiscal year-end balance sheet, two quarters earlier, not the prior quarter. Cash at the beginning of Q2 FY27 was $13,237M per the cash flow statement.

claims.claim: Long-term debt was $32.4 billion.
Long-term debt rose from $7.5 billion in the prior quarter.
claims.note: The $7,469M comparative is as of January 25, 2026 (fiscal year-end), not the prior quarter; the release gives no April 26, 2026 balance sheet.

claims.claim: Guidance assumes no revenue from China.
claims.note: The release excludes only Data Center compute revenue from China, not all China revenue; the brief's restatement broadens the exclusion.

claims.claim: Operating expenses increased $8.4 billion quarter over quarter.
claims.note: $8,408M is the Q2 FY27 GAAP operating expense level, not the increase; the sequential increase was $787M (from $7,621M).

claims.claim: Operating expenses rose 10% quarter over quarter.
Third-quarter GAAP operating expense guidance is $9.2 billion.
Full-year fiscal 2027 tax rate guidance is 16.0% to 18.0%, excluding discrete items.
